svg.title: Accuracy versus price, 22 October 2026
svg.desc: Higher and further left is better. Price runs from $0.10 to $100 on a logarithmic horizontal axis. Accuracy is on the left vertical axis, from 0 to 100%. Hollow dots have conditional prices or separate samples.
svg.text: Estimated USD / 1,000 lookups · log scale · ← cheaper

circle.title: OpenTaxRate API: 98.9%, $1.95/1,000. Keyed plan; first 100 free excluded. The measured run enabled all configured providers with Geocodio’s quota exhausted; production quotas and budgets can change coverage.

Geoverio: 82.3%, $0.50/1,000. PAYG $0.50 per 1,000 requests, no monthly fee. At 2,000 lookups/month: $1.00/month. The separate free plan and subscription capacity prices are not used for this point. Full street-address inputs on the same 277 officially labeled evalA cases.
TaxCloud: 89.6%, $39.50/1,000. Historical illustration: $79/month ÷ 2,000 × 1,000 from the 21 October reading. Current page exposes no price; API allowance needs confirmation.
TaxJar: 98.2%, $49.50/1,000. $99/month Professional, 200 orders = 2,000 rate lookups; no imported orders. Full monthly allowance used.
Avalara AvaTax: 99.6%, $29.12/1,000. Illustration only: $699/year for ONE paid state ÷ 12 ÷ 2,000 × 1,000. Nationwide API access and contract cost are not established.

APIVerve: 87.4%, $14.99/1,000. Separate sample: 76/87 correct (87.4%), ZIP-code input only; not the 277-address evalA sample, so excluded from frontier ranking. Starter is $29.99/month for 200,000 credits, at 2 credits/call. At the chart’s 2,000 lookups/month: $29.99 ÷ 2 = $14.995 per 1,000. The $0.30 figure requires using all 100,000 included calls.

svg.text: 2,000 lookups/month · 22 October 2026 · Hollow dots: conditional price or separate sample.
APIVerve: ZIP-only, n=87. Full assumptions and sources: opentaxrate.com/benchmarks.
